_readme: Single source of truth for every portfolio entry. Add a project by appending an object; the build creates its card, filters, case-study page, sitemap entry and social preview automatically. status: live | pilot | prototype | in-development | archived. type: own-product | research | client | community | concept. Set published:false to keep an entry out of the build. Never put a private repository in publicSource. Screenshot files live at static/img/projects/<slug>.webp (+ -640.webp) and static/img/og/<slug>.jpg.

projects.title: UK AI Economic Measurement Lab
projects.summary: An independent research prototype exploring how artificial intelligence could be identified and measured within UK National Accounts frameworks.
projects.audience: Economists, statisticians and policy analysts interested in how AI activity shows up in economic statistics.
projects.problem: AI activity sits inside broad product and industry totals, so published figures mix AI and non-AI output. Anyone trying to reason about AI's economic footprint needs a transparent way to separate candidate denominators from scenario estimates.
projects.role: Sole author: research design, data layer, statistical methods and web application.
projects.solution: A set of linked research tools: an AI production-stack explorer, a supply-and-use explorer covering 23 AI-relevant CPA product groups, a disaggregation lab with four scenario methods and sensitivity curves, a business-classification benchmark, an SNA 2008 / ESA 2010 asset-boundary decision tool, adoption context and a register of measurement gaps.
features: Supply-and-use explorer for 23 AI-relevant product groups
Four disaggregation scenario methods with parameter sensitivity
Rule-based and statistical business classifier with a published benchmark
Asset-boundary decision tool with worked case studies
Method cards, data-quality scoring and a source register
projects.outcomes: Live and publicly browsable. The repository records 38 automated statistical tests and a documented route-by-route deployment check.
limitations: Not an ONS product, not endorsed by ONS and does not produce official statistics.
Decompositions are illustrative research scenarios, not estimates of AI output.
The public repository holds documentation; application source is not published there.
projects.imageAlt: UK AI Economic Measurement Lab overview page with navigation to each research module and a statistical safeguard notice
projects.caption: Overview page. Every view carries the independence notice and treats product totals as candidate denominators, not AI output.

projects.title: Performance Insight Explorer
projects.statusNote: Live demo on Streamlit Community Cloud
projects.summary: Upload an unfamiliar operational dataset and work through profiling, data-quality checks, KPI set-up, trends, root-cause exploration and exportable reporting.
projects.audience: Operational managers, performance analysts and teams that receive spreadsheets in inconsistent formats.
projects.problem: Performance data often arrives with unknown columns, gaps and errors. Teams spend their time cleaning and re-building the same charts instead of deciding what to do.
projects.solution: A schema-flexible Streamlit application that profiles a dataset, scores data quality across ten dimensions, lets users define KPIs without code, and produces trend, control-chart and driver analysis with presentation-ready exports.
features: Upload CSV, Excel, Parquet or JSON and profile it automatically
Ten-dimension data-quality checks with remediation choices
No-code KPI builder with targets and thresholds
Statistical process control charts, comparisons and driver analysis
Exports to PowerPoint, PDF, Excel and Markdown
projects.outcomes: Working public demo. The repository includes an automated test suite and sample datasets across several sectors.
limitations: Free hosting: the app can take a minute to wake after inactivity.
A prototype for exploration and demonstration, not a managed enterprise service.
projects.imageAlt: Performance Insight Explorer showing the workflow sidebar and the dataset upload stage
projects.caption: The guided workflow: define the question, upload data, then move through quality checks, KPIs and findings.

projects.title: PriceLab
projects.statusNote: Demo requires sign-in; the hosted demo predates the 1.0 build
projects.summary: Turns a messy price collection into a matched-model price index, a written method note, and a report and slide deck you can send on.
projects.audience: Analysts and organisations who compile price data and need results they can defend.
projects.problem: Real price collections arrive with sentinel values, unit errors, seasonal gaps and rotating samples. Handling them badly changes the index invisibly.
projects.role: Designer and developer of the methods library and application.
projects.solution: A library-first Python application that infers the schema, validates structure, diagnoses missing data by mechanism, repairs unit errors rather than deleting them, builds a chained Jevons index (with other formulae when quantities are supplied), ranks findings and exports a report, deck and reproducible configuration.
features: Schema inference and one-pass structural validation
Missing-data diagnosis by mechanism (seasonal vs collection failure)
Unit-error detection and repair with residual checks
Role-based access and a hash-chained audit log
Exports: Word report, slide deck, flagged data and configuration
projects.outcomes: Repository-level capability: features above are implemented in the source. The public demo runs an earlier version.
limitations: The hosted demo predates the 1.0 platform build and requires an account.
Independent tool; not an official statistics product.

projects.title: Price Quality Explorer
projects.summary: A reproducible workflow for consumer-price data quality and matched-product index analysis, built on synthetic research data.
projects.audience: Analysts working with consumer price microdata.
projects.problem: Price microdata contains zero quotes, scale errors and seasonal items. Without a transparent audit trail, index results are hard to check.
projects.solution: A Streamlit application that validates the data, flags anomalies without overwriting raw values, builds matched-product Jevons indices, profiles seasonality and runs sensitivity checks, with audience-specific PDF briefings, a slide deck and calculation workbooks.
features: Anomaly flagging that preserves original values
Matched-product index construction and seasonality profiles
Sensitivity checks against an alternative method
Audience-tailored PDF, PowerPoint and Excel outputs
projects.outcomes: Methodology illustration on synthetic data. Results are not official estimates.
limitations: Uses synthetic research data; not an official ONS product.
The hosted demo is not currently accessible. Source is private.
projects.liveCheck: Demo URL returns "no access / does not exist"
projects.imageAlt: Price Quality Explorer upload screen with workflow steps listed on the right
projects.caption: Upload stage and the workflow from data acquisition to export.

projects.title: Care Quality Intelligence
projects.summary: A quality-monitoring platform for adult social care that turns incidents, complaints and feedback into fair staff-level insight, supervision packs and inspection evidence.
projects.audience: Registered managers, directors and team leaders in residential, supported-living and outreach services.
projects.problem: Care providers keep quality evidence across spreadsheets. Raw incident counts can unfairly penalise staff who work more shifts or report more conscientiously.
projects.role: Product designer, analyst and full-stack developer.
projects.solution: A role-based web application that normalises every staff metric per 100 delivered sessions, suppresses judgements on small samples, generates print-ready supervision packs and maps evidence to inspection themes.
features: Organisation, service and staff-level quality dashboards
Quality Risk Index normalised per 100 sessions
Role-based access, enforced by the API
People supported identified only by reference codes
projects.outcomes: Working demo with 12 months of deterministic synthetic data across four fictitious services.
limitations: Demo data is synthetic and does not represent real people or services.
Free hosting: the first load can take up to a minute.
Not endorsed by CQC; evidence mapping supports, but does not replace, a provider's own judgement.
projects.liveCheck: Loads to sign-in page with published demo accounts
projects.imageAlt: Care Quality Intelligence quality overview with indicator tiles and monthly incident charts
projects.caption: Quality overview using synthetic demo data.

projects.title: UKCalc
projects.summary: 253 free UK calculators across 19 categories, from income tax and stamp duty to pensions, ISAs and everyday conversions.
projects.audience: UK individuals, sole traders, homebuyers and analysts.
projects.problem: UK financial rules change every tax year and are hard to apply by hand. Many calculator sites hide their assumptions.
projects.role: Product owner and developer: calculation engine, rules package, registry and web application.
projects.solution: A registry-driven calculator platform: a shared calculation engine returns inputs, outputs, warnings and assumptions in a stable format, and UK rules are versioned by tax year.
features: Tax-year-versioned UK rules (2026/27 shown on relevant tools)
Shared calculation engine with stated assumptions
projects.outcomes: Live and publicly available; the calculator count is taken from the live site.
limitations: General information only, not financial or tax advice.
The repository's earlier foundation notes describe a smaller first wave; the live site reflects the current build.
projects.imageAlt: UKCalc home page listing calculator categories and featured UK tax and mortgage calculators
projects.caption: Category browser and featured calculators.

projects.title: GarageProof UK
projects.summary: A digital repair workflow for independent garages: vehicle check-in, inspection evidence, itemised estimates, customer approval links and an audit trail.
projects.audience: Independent UK garages and mobile mechanics.
projects.problem: Repair approvals often happen by phone and paper. When a customer disputes a charge, there is little evidence of what was found, quoted and agreed.
projects.role: Product designer and full-stack developer, including the earlier AutoDamage Quote bodywork-quoting work that the platform grew from.
projects.solution: A multi-tenant web application with an API, shared calculation and damage-quote packages, customer approval links that need no account, and a timestamped record of each decision.
features: Job check-in and inspection notes with photos
Customer approval or decline via a secure link
Staff invitations and per-garage data separation
projects.outcomes: Pilot access in place for invited garages. No usage figures are published.
limitations: Pilot only; sign-in required.
Source is private.
projects.imageAlt: GarageProof jobs overview with job counts and a list of recent repair jobs (demo data)
projects.caption: Jobs overview with demo data: each job moves from check-in to customer approval and completion.

projects.title: CarePhrase
projects.summary: A free coaching tool that helps care workers write clearer, more factual care notes without writing the note for them.
projects.audience: UK healthcare assistants and support workers.
projects.problem: Care notes are read by colleagues, families and inspectors. Vague or judgemental wording causes problems, and many staff receive little feedback on their writing.
projects.solution: A web app that gives structured feedback on clarity, professionalism, completeness and safeguarding language, and asks reflective questions so the writer improves their own note.
features: Care note coaching (never rewrites the note)
projects.outcomes: Live and free to use without an account.
limitations: A training aid, not clinical advice or an official care record.
Users should not enter identifiable personal information.
projects.imageAlt: CarePhrase home page explaining the four-part care note framework
projects.caption: Home page and the four-part care note framework.

projects.title: CarePhrase Communication Academy
projects.statusNote: MVP with pilot feedback; sign-in required
projects.summary: Voice-based communication practice for care teams, with structured, scored feedback on handovers and other workplace scenarios.
projects.audience: Care homes, home-care providers and training providers.
projects.problem: Handovers and escalations are spoken, time-pressured and safety-critical, but rarely rehearsed outside real shifts.
projects.solution: Learners record spoken responses to realistic scenarios in the browser, receive a transcript and feedback scored on clarity, completeness, professional language, safety awareness and structure, and track progress on a dashboard.
features: Handover module working end to end
In-browser voice recording on mobile and desktop
Email sign-in with row-level data security
projects.outcomes: First module complete; further modules are scaffolded.
limitations: Training tool only; not clinical advice and not a medical device.
Escalation and Care English modules are still in development.
projects.imageAlt: CarePhrase Communication Academy learner dashboard with scores and training modules
projects.caption: Learner dashboard (developer test account; personal details removed).

projects.title: TaxMate UK
projects.summary: Income and expense records for UK sole traders, with tax-year-aware summaries, kept entirely in the browser.
projects.problem: Sole traders need a simple way to see income received, money still owed and expenses in the right tax year.
projects.solution: A responsive web app that separates received, invoiced, outstanding and overdue income, scopes figures to the 6 April tax year, and exports backups as JSON or CSV.
projects.outcomes: Calculations covered by unit tests; workflows covered by end-to-end tests in CI.
limitations: Prototype: data is stored only in the browser, with no account or backup service.
UK tax rules are not yet implemented; not for filing decisions or tax advice.
projects.imageAlt: TaxMate UK dashboard with income, expenses and an income-versus-expenses chart (demo data)
projects.caption: Dashboard with demo records.

projects.title: Professional Speaking Trainer
projects.summary: Structured speaking drills with a live transcript and feedback on pace, filler words and delivery.
projects.audience: People preparing for interviews, presentations and workplace updates.
projects.problem: Speaking skills improve with practice and feedback, but most people rehearse without either.
projects.solution: A browser app with timed drills (introductions, STAR answers, briefings, presentation openings, recovering from a mind blank) that uses the browser's own speech recognition to transcribe and score delivery.
limitations: Speech recognition quality depends on the browser; works best in Chrome or Edge.
projects.imageAlt: Professional Speaking Trainer practice screen with drill options
projects.caption: Drill selection and practice workspace.

projects.title: Kogi Quest
projects.summary: An interactive quiz game about the history, culture and traditions of Kogi State, Nigeria, with a community leaderboard.
projects.audience: The Kogi diaspora, students and anyone curious about the region.
projects.problem: Local history is often passed on informally. A game makes it easier to share and remember.
projects.solution: A React quiz game with a secure leaderboard: players can read scores, but writes go through a single database function.
projects.caption: Start screen.

projects.title: Takete-Ide Amuro community website
projects.summary: A community website and heritage archive for Takete-Ide Amuro in Kogi State, Nigeria, with an admin area for updates.
projects.audience: Residents, the diaspora and visitors interested in the community's history and development.
projects.problem: Community history, events and development updates were scattered and hard to preserve.
projects.solution: A content-managed website with a heritage archive, event pages, a development dashboard, a gallery, a families and oríkì (praise poetry) archive with a submission and review workflow, and a role-based admin portal.
features: Families and oríkì archive with community submissions
Honest empty states when content is not yet added
projects.imageAlt: Takete-Ide Amuro website home page with navigation and centenary celebration banner
projects.caption: Home page.

projects.title: Aldanat Care FC Match Predictor
projects.statusNote: Built for a single charity fixture (26 August 2026); site still online
projects.summary: A free score-prediction page and organiser desk console for a staff charity football match in aid of Cardiac Risk in the Young.
projects.audience: Match attendees and the event organiser.
projects.problem: The organiser needed a simple way to take predictions and track voluntary pledges on the day, without handling money in the app.
projects.role: Designer and developer, including the organiser pack and reconciliation workbook.
projects.solution: A dependency-free single-page app with transparent scoring rules, plus a desk console to record entries and pledges, publish the result and export a CSV for reconciliation.
features: Free entry with optional voluntary pledge
Organiser desk console with CSV export
projects.outcomes: Used as the entry point for the event. No figures are published.
limitations: No stake, prize or payout; pledges are voluntary donations and no payment is processed by the app.
Each device keeps its own copy of entries; designed around one desk device.
projects.imageAlt: Charity match predictor entry form for the Supported Living versus Residential fixture
projects.caption: Entry form.

projects.title: NairaGuard
projects.summary: A mobile-first prototype showing how counterfeit Naira checks could work from a phone photo.
projects.audience: People handling cash in everyday transactions in Nigeria.
projects.problem: Counterfeit notes are hard to spot quickly at the point of sale.
projects.solution: A single-file web app with camera capture, a reference gallery of note denominations, a learning section on security features and local scan history.
limitations: Analysis is simulated; it does not detect counterfeit notes.
Not affiliated with the Central Bank of Nigeria.
projects.liveCheck: Loads; displays its own demo-version notice
projects.imageAlt: NairaGuard scanner screen with a notice that analysis is simulated
projects.caption: Scanner screen. The app labels itself as a demo with simulated analysis.

projects.title: UBA Pulse (concept)
projects.summary: An independent mobile-banking interface concept exploring fast onboarding and simple transfers.
projects.problem: A design exploration of how a bank app could feel as quick as fintech competitors.
projects.solution: A React prototype of a six-step onboarding flow and transfer screens.
limitations: Not affiliated with or endorsed by United Bank for Africa.
No banking integrations; no real accounts or payments.
projects.imageAlt: UBA Pulse concept onboarding screen asking for a phone number
projects.caption: Onboarding concept, step one.

projects.title: DEAP Tax Compliance
projects.summary: A compliance-support workspace for organisations' tax records and reporting, in early development.
projects.problem: Organisations need one place to keep tax records organised and see what is due.
projects.solution: A React and Supabase application with sign-in; further detail will be published as development progresses.
limitations: Not regulated tax advice and no guarantee of compliance outcomes.
